analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 ($57.07)/SMA200 ($51.86) — Strong mid-to-long term bullish trend.
· 52-week position (78.6%) + Current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (68.1→60.5) — Cooling from overbought, attempting to enter neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.5647→0.2274) — Improving in positive territory, showing signs of weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $56.68) — Sideways consolidation around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($55.99) — Support level based on Pivot S1 ($54.18) and SMA50/100.
· Swing Resistance ($59.38) — Resistance level near 5-day high and Pivot R1 ($62.01).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Not Higher Low, Not Lower High) — Diagnosed as a sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.48x) — Below 5-day average volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation) — Maintaining a 'watch' stance due to lack of trend formation (ADX) and subdued volume.
